title: Type inference broken for tool calls after dynamic tools introduction in v5.0.0-beta.29

linked_prs.title: feat (ai): add static/dynamic toolCalls/toolResults helpers
linked_prs.body:
## Background

The introduction of dynamic tools in #7595 broke type inference in several scenarios (see #7615 ).

## Summary

Given that we want to keep both dynamic tools calls/results and static tools calls/results in a single calls/results array, the type inference limitations cannot be resolved directly. However, it is possible to expose subsets for static/dynamic calls/results that have the expected typing. This has the advantage that it makes it explicit that you are only accessing static or dynamic calls/results.

* renamed `ToolCallUnion` to `TypedToolCall`
* expose `StaticToolCall` and `DynamicToolCall` types
* renamed `ToolResultUnion` to `TypedToolResult`
* expose `StaticToolResult` and `DynamicToolResult` types
* expose `StaticToolError`, `DynamicToolError`, `TypedToolError` types
* add `staticToolCall` and `dynamicToolCalls` helpers to `generateText`, `streamText`, `Step`
* add `staticToolResult` and `dynamicToolResult` helpers to `generateText`, `streamText`, `Step`

## Verification

Verified type inference works as before when switching to `static*` helpers.

## Tasks

- [x] tool call types
- [x] tool result types
- [x] tool error types
- [x] generate tool call
- [x] generate tool result
- [x] stream tool call
- [x] stream tool result
- [x] step too call
- [x] step tool result
- [x] changeset

## Related Issues

Resolves #7615
